teaser: Websites you own: a reply to an infographic that rents AI-built websites by the month, and the one-off model I propose.
core_idea: Selling AI-built websites by the month gets the economics wrong: rent pays most when clients use least, a few clients never stop asking, and page caps are arbitrary when static pages cost almost nothing; instead the client should own an AI account, GitHub Pages and a domain, and buy a finished job of setup, build, design choice, QA and handover, with blocks of hours only if wanted.
